t2.thesis: Aggressive downward EPS revisions and persistent investor anxiety over surging AI capex and margin compression outweigh the reduced valuation bar, tilting the immediate reaction odds moderately negative.
reasons: META has dropped after 3 of its last 4 earnings prints (win rate 25%), driven by recurrent market pushback on capex guidance.
Current-quarter EPS estimates have been aggressively slashed by 21.6% over 90 days (from $7.06 to $5.54), including an 11.5% cut in the last 7 days.
Free cash flow collapsed to $784 million in Q2 2026 as quarterly capex surged to $31.1 billion, leaving little margin for error on 2026/2027 capex commentary.
t2.deciding_variable: FY2026/2027 capex guidance and commentary on AI infrastructure spend relative to ad revenue acceleration.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered 8 percentage points from the 0.54 prior due to poor recent print history (1 of 4 positive), severe late-stage EPS revisions, and high capex drag, partially offset by a deeply oversold 5-day setup (-9.5%) and mild call skew.

theses.expected: Capex guidance increases or remains elevated while Q4 revenue outlook merely matches expectations, triggering an open drop.
theses.mechanism: Investors remain sensitive to deteriorating free cash flow and margin contraction from unprecedented infrastructure investments.
theses.wrong_if: Management demonstrates that AI integration has meaningfully accelerated ad pricing and business messaging monetization enough to exceed elevated expense run-rates.

theses.expected: Relief bounce after recent 9.5% 5-day pre-earnings selloff on meeting newly lowered consensus EPS of $5.54.
theses.mechanism: Oversold positioning and low hedge skew allow a standard top-line beat to squeeze short-term bears.
theses.wrong_if: Legal reserves or youth litigation developments trigger an additional unexpected GAAP earnings charge.

theses.expected: Family of Apps advertising growth decelerates in Europe and North America under regulatory and platform tracking constraints.
theses.mechanism: Weaker ad conversion updates diminish the multiple despite reasonable user growth.
theses.wrong_if: WhatsApp monetization and Muse AI commercial uptake show upside surprises that open new revenue avenues.

key_observations: Free cash flow generation relative to quarterly capex spend
Average price per ad and ad impression growth rates
